page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor providing 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU configuration includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, alongside support for instruction sets including AVX-512 (supporting VNNI and BF16) and cryptographic hardware acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators, relying on network-attached storage solutions. In synthetic tests, the instance demonstrates strong single-core performance with a stress-ng score of 2864.98, placing it in the top quartile of tested instances. Multi-core compute performance sits in the middle tiers, delivering a stress-ng multi-core score of 11479.63 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 6794.0.

Memory throughput profiles exhibit a stark division depending on data locality. Cached small-block memory reads achieve 565.97 GB/sec, whereas uncached large-block performance drops into the lower tiers, registering 37.36 GB/sec for reads and 14.86 GB/sec for writes. Similarly, while lightweight tasks such as 135M-parameter model inference execute at a sustained 174.59 tokens per second, medium-scale 7B-parameter generation drops to 5.95 tokens per second due to memory throughput bottlenecks outside the processor cache.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, the c3d-standard-8 provides a balanced allocation of modern AMD compute and system memory for standard enterprise workloads. It delivers steady throughput for web serving (10.45 GB/sec) and in-memory key-value processing, managing 10.24 million Redis SET operations per second. The instance is well suited for web serving, microservices, continuous integration pipelines, application middleware, and balanced database workloads.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-8 is a general-purpose virtual instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM, powered by a 4-core AMD EPYC 9B14 processor on the x86_64 architecture with multithreading and AVX-512 instruction support. The server includes no integrated GPUs or local disks, requiring external volumes for persistence. Benchmark results indicate strong single-core compute performance within the top 25 percent, while overall multi-core computational throughput and cached memory transfers remain steady. Uncached memory read and write bandwidth show reduced throughput, and large model inference demonstrates significant memory-bound limitations. Featuring a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, this instance is suited for general web serving, application backends, container orchestration, and standard enterprise workloads.

32.0 GB system memory providing a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio
